name: browser_close
description: Close the browser and all open tabs.

name: browser_resize
description: Resize the browser window

name: browser_console_messages
description: Return the page's console messages.

level.description: Minimum level; each level includes more severe ones.

all.description: Return messages since the session started, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

filename.description: File to save to; relative paths resolve against the workspace root. Omit to return text.

name: browser_handle_dialog
description: Accept or dismiss a dialog.

promptText.description: Text to enter in a prompt dialog.

name: browser_emulate_media
description: Emulate CSS media features, e.g. light/dark color scheme. Omitted parameters stay unchanged; null clears an override.

media.description: CSS media type of the page

name: browser_evaluate
description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression on the page or an element.

element.description: Human-readable element description, used to get permission to interact with it

target.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

filename.description: File to save the result to; relative paths resolve against the workspace root. Omit to return text.

name: browser_file_upload
description: Upload one or more files.

paths.description: Absolute paths of the files to upload. Omit to cancel the file chooser.

name: browser_drop
description: Drop files or MIME-typed data onto an element, as if dragged from outside the page. Provide paths, data, or both.

element.description: Human-readable element description, used to get permission to interact with it

target.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

paths.description: Absolute paths of files to drop.

data.description: Map of MIME type to string value, e.g. {"text/plain": "hello", "text/uri-list": "https://example.com"}.

name: browser_find
description: Search the page's accessibility snapshot for text or a regex. Returns matching nodes with a few lines of context under their tree path; cheaper than a full snapshot when you only need to locate an element and its ref.

text.description: Case-insensitive substring to find. Use text or regex, not both.

regex.description: Regex to find, case-sensitive by default; wrap in slashes for flags, e.g. "/error/i". Use text or regex, not both.

maxResults.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to all.

filename.description: Save results to this file instead of returning them; relative paths resolve against the workspace root.

name: browser_fill_form
description: Fill several form fields at once.

element.description: Human-readable element description, used to get permission to interact with it

target.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

value.description: Value to fill: `true`/`false` for a checkbox, the option text for a combobox.

name: browser_press_key
description: Press a keyboard key.

key.description: Key name or character, e.g. `ArrowLeft` or `a`

name: browser_type
description: Type text into an editable element.

element.description: Human-readable element description, used to get permission to interact with it

target.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

slowly.description: Type one character at a time, to trigger key handlers. By default the whole text is filled at once.

name: browser_navigate
description: Navigate to a URL

name: browser_navigate_back
description: Go back to the previous page in history.

name: browser_network_requests
description: List the network requests since the page loaded, numbered. Get full details of one with browser_network_request.

static.description: Include successful static resources (images, fonts, scripts, etc.). Defaults to false.

filter.description: Only requests whose URL matches this regex, e.g. "/api/.*user".

all.description: Return requests since the session started, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

filename.description: File to save to; relative paths resolve against the workspace root. Omit to return text.

name: browser_network_request
description: Get full details (headers and body) of one network request, or one part if `part` is set. Use the number from browser_network_requests.

part.description: Return only this part. Omit for full details.

filename.description: File to save to; relative paths resolve against the workspace root. Omit to return text.

name: browser_run_code_unsafe
description: Run a Playwright code snippet. Unsafe: executes arbitrary JavaScript in the Playwright server process and is RCE-equivalent.

code.description: JavaScript function called with one argument, page. Example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

filename.description: Load the code from this file; relative paths resolve against the workspace root. If both are given, code is ignored.

name: browser_take_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the current page. For actions, use browser_snapshot by default. With the vision capability, use screenshot coordinates with the coordinate-based mouse tools for elements missing from the accessibility snapshot.

element.description: Human-readable element description, used to get permission to interact with it

target.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

type.description: Image format. If unset, inferred from the filename extension, else png.

filename.description: File to save to; relative paths resolve against the workspace root. Default: `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg|webp}` in the output directory.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of the viewport. Not allowed with element screenshots.

scale.description: "css": sized in CSS pixels (smaller, same on every device). "device": device pixels (larger, high resolution).

name: browser_snapshot
description: Capture the current page's accessibility snapshot; better than a screenshot.

target.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

filename.description: Save the snapshot to this file instead of returning it; relative paths resolve against the workspace root.

boxes.description: Add each element's bounding box as [box=x,y,width,height]: viewport-relative CSS pixels (getBoundingClientRect).

name: browser_click
description: Click an element on the page.

element.description: Human-readable element description, used to get permission to interact with it

target.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

name: browser_drag
description: Drag and drop from one element to another.

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description, used to get permission to interact with it

startTarget.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description, used to get permission to interact with it

endTarget.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

name: browser_hover
description: Hover over an element on the page.

element.description: Human-readable element description, used to get permission to interact with it

target.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

name: browser_select_option
description: Select options in a dropdown.

element.description: Human-readable element description, used to get permission to interact with it

target.description: Exact element ref from the page snapshot, or a unique selector

values.description: One or more values to select

name: browser_tabs
description: List, open, close, or select browser tabs.

index.description: Tab index for close/select. Close without it closes the current tab.

url.description: URL to open in the new tab (new only).

isolatedContext.description: Isolated browser context for the new tab (new only). Tabs in the same context share cookies and storage; different contexts are fully isolated. Omitted or "default" uses the default context.

name: browser_wait_for
description: Wait for text to appear or disappear, or for a time to pass. With both text and textGone, waits for whichever happens first.

time.description: Seconds to wait, at most 30. With text or textGone, acts as their timeout instead of the default action timeout.
